REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
AGENDA NO. 855
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday JANUARY 12, 2017
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Eneix
Commissioners French, Velador and Ward
4. Review of Agenda

8. Public Hearings
OLD BUSINESS:
8A. TENTATIVE Tract Map (TTM) 53920 Time Extension (TE) No. 2
Mr. Andrew Hsu, Applicant
(Continued from December 9, 2016)
A request for a three-year time extension to subdivide 59.7 acres into 229 residential lots including one multi-lot detention basin located at the northeast corner of Fort Tejon Road and 50th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission take the following actions: adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-004 approving Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 53920 Time Extension (TE) and find that the project will not result in any changes to the Mitigated Negative Declaration adopted for TTM 53920 on September 21, 2006.
NEW BUSINESS: Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8A
NEW BUSINESS
8B. General Plan Amendment 16-001/Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 60500 Time Extension (TE)
LA-DF Investment Fund 78, LLC, Applicant
A request to revise the land use designation on 66.77 acres of property associated with Tentative Tract Maps 53342 and 60500 from SFR-3 to SP-Rancho Vista; and Tentative Tract Map 60500 Time Extension a request for a three year time extension for the subdivision of 30.68 acres into 65 single-family residential lots and one detention basin lot located south of Vista Point Way and West of Rancho Vista Boulevard.
8B
8C. Tentative Parcel Map 74075
Mr. Jehangir Yeganeh, Applicant
A request to subdivide approximately 80 acres into four industrial lots located south of Avenue L and West of 40th Street East (APN 3170-015-007).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-002 approving the subdivision of approximately 80 acres into four industrial lots; and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Victor Mendez, Assistant Planner
8C
8D. General Plan Amendment (GPA) 15-002, Zone Change (ZC) 15-002, Density Bonus Agreement (DBA 16-001), Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 73740 and Site Plan Review (SPR) 15-007
Habitat for Humanity, Applicant
General Plan Amendment (GPA) 15-002, Zone Change (ZC) 15-002, Density Bonus Agreement (DBA) 16-001, Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 73740 and Site Plan Review (SPR) 15-007; an application by Habitat for Humanity to construct a 56 condominium unit subdivision on 9.9 acres located at the southeast corner of Taintor Road and Division Street.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission take the following actions: adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-003 approving Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 73740, Site Plan Review (SPR) 15-007; recommend that the City Council approve General Plan Amendment (GPA) 15-002, Zone Change (ZC) 15-002, and Density Bonus Agreement (DBA) 16-001; and find that the project will not result in significant impact on the environment by adopting the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring Program prepared for the project. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
8D
8E. Planned Development (PD) 16-001, Tentative Parcel Map (TPM) 73748, and Site Plan Review (SPR) 15-006
Jones Lang LaSalle, Applicant
A request for approval of a comprehensive master plan for the construction of a 420,000 square foot medical/commercial mixed-use project located at the southeast corner of Palmdale Boulevard and Tierra Subida Avenue.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission take the following actions: adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-005 approving Planned Development 16-001, Tentative Parcel Map 73748 and Site Plan Review 15-006 based on the findings within the draft resolution and subject to the conditions of approval; and find that the previous Mitigated Negative Declaration adopted on October 5, 2016, adequately addresses the project. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
8E
9. Staff Communications Development Update
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
